pos.personaBrief: Total Football aimed at dominating possession and spreading play (These Football Times, Guide to Football, Substack: possession and pressing), but won the ball high to attack, never ceding it to counter.

pro.personaBrief: Fluid triangular passing, goalkeeper as libero playing outside the area and risk at the back, yet ruthlessly direct when the chance appeared (1974 verified facts).

est.personaBrief: Positional interchange in vertical lines with total oscillation (FourFourTwo, These Football Times); players rotate roles, strikers and defenders roam.

lar.personaBrief: Pitch made as large as possible, spreading play to wings, Rep and Rensenbrink wide and full-backs Suurbier and Krol overlapping (FIFA, These Football Times).

blo.personaBrief: Collective pressing, space reduction, high line with offside trap, defenders forward and forwards back; 'presion total' (verified facts across Ajax, Barcelona, Netherlands).

mar.personaBrief: Space-oriented compact block that exposed man-marking limits (FourFourTwo), with one assigned man-marking role, Neeskens on the playmaker (Irish Times).

pla.personaBrief: Imposed the Ajax system at Barcelona and demanded players adapt or leave; the same 4-3-3, pressing and offside line everywhere, though he balanced teams with the opposition in mind (FIFA quote).

res.personaBrief: Proactive, attacking identity ('defend forwards'), no longer prioritising a clean sheet (Substack); lost the 1974 final yet is remembered; 'football is war' shows competitiveness.

sis.personaBrief: Collective system and demand for total footballers; even stars like Cruyff had duties, and strict rules benched stars at Barcelona (Substack).

jog.personaBrief: Total footballer: fit, smart, tough and versatile; brutal physical preparation (four or five sessions a day) combined with technical intelligence.

bas.personaBrief: Built on Ajax players who grew together from youth level and nurtured talent (Irish Times, These Football Times), but also signed Vasovic and brought Cruyff and Neeskens to Barcelona.

lid.personaBrief: Known as 'The General' and 'Mister Marble': strict discipline, uncompromising, benched stars, the message was those who disliked it would leave.
